ModMetadata.Name: Faster Frame Finishing
ModMetadata.Author: Faster Frame Finishing contributors
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: 1.0.0 - First release. The plastic-sheet finishing step on steel frames is 5x faster by default. Speed is adjustable, and there is an optional instant mode.
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]🔧 Faster Frame Finishing[/h1] Tired of holding the screwdriver on every single steel frame? This mod makes the [b]last step of building a steel frame[/b] (the plastic sheet + screwdriver finish) [b]5× faster[/b].
[b]2.0 seconds → 0.4 seconds[/b] per frame. Nothing else changes.
[h2]✨ Features[/h2] [list] [*]⚡ [b]5× faster[/b] plastic-sheet finishing on steel frames, out of the box [*]🎚️ [b]Adjustable speed.[/b] Pick any speed you like, or go back to normal [*]💨 [b]Optional instant mode[/b] for the truly impatient [*]🧱 [b]Everything else stays vanilla:[/b] placing frames, welding steel sheets, taking frames apart, other structures [*]📦 [b]Same materials:[/b] still uses 1 plastic sheet per frame, and you still need your screwdriver [*]💾 [b]Save-safe:[/b] add or remove it at any time, and your saves are not affected [*]👥 [b]Multiplayer friendly:[/b] works even if the server or other players don't have it [/list]
[h2]📋 Requirements[/h2] This mod needs two free tools. You only install them [b]once[/b], and many other mods use them too: [list] [*][b]BepInEx 5[/b] [*][url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list] Already using other Stationeers mods? You probably have both already. Skip to step 3!
[h2]🚀 How to install[/h2] [olist] [*][b]Install BepInEx and StationeersLaunchPad[/b] (one time only). Follow the short, step-by-step guide on the [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad#installation]StationeersLaunchPad page[/url]. [*][b]Start Stationeers once[/b] to check it works. You'll see a [b]LaunchPad[/b] box at the bottom of the loading screen. [*][b]Click Subscribe[/b] at the top of this page. [*][b]Start Stationeers.[/b] LaunchPad loads the mod automatically. [*]That's it! 🎉 Finish a steel frame with a screwdriver and plastic sheets, and enjoy the extra free time. [/olist]
💡 [i]If the mod doesn't seem to load, click the LaunchPad box on the loading screen and check that [b]Faster Frame Finishing[/b] is ticked.[/i]
[h2]⚙️ Settings[/h2] To change settings, go to the [b]main menu → Workshop[/b], click [b]Faster Frame Finishing[/b], and use the [b]Mod Configuration[/b] panel on the right. You can also change them in the LaunchPad window while the game is loading.
[table] [tr][th]Setting[/th][th]Default[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td]Enabled[/td][td]On[/td][td]Turn the mod on or off. Off = normal game speed.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]SpeedMultiplier[/td][td]5[/td][td]How much faster finishing is. 1 = normal, 2 = twice as fast, 10 = ten times as fast. Anything from 0.1 to 100.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]InstantFinish[/td][td]Off[/td][td]Finish frames almost instantly, whatever the speed setting.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]DebugLogging[/td][td]Off[/td][td]Extra details in the log file. Only needed when reporting a problem.[/td][/tr] [/table]
🔄 [b]Restart the game after changing a setting[/b] for it to take effect.
[h2]👥 Multiplayer[/h2] [list] [*]Everyone who wants faster finishing installs the mod on [b]their own game[/b]. [*]The [b]server does not need it[/b], and players without it can still join and play normally (they keep the normal speed). [*]Plastic sheets are still used and frames still seal exactly as normal for everyone. [/list]
[h2]❓ FAQ[/h2] [b]Does it change any other building steps?[/b] No. Only the final plastic-sheet + screwdriver step on steel frames gets faster. Placing frames, welding steel sheets, deconstructing and every other structure work exactly as normal.
[b]Does it work on iron frames?[/b] Iron frames don't have a plastic finishing step, so there's nothing to speed up. They're left untouched.
[b]Will it break my save?[/b] No. The mod doesn't store anything in your save. You can remove it at any time.
[b]Can I make it slower instead?[/b] Yes! Set SpeedMultiplier below 1 (for example 0.5 for half speed).
[b]A game update came out. Is the mod still working?[/b] If an update changes how frames are built, the mod safely switches itself off and the game behaves normally until the mod is updated. It won't crash your game.
[h2]🗑️ Uninstalling[/h2] Just click [b]Unsubscribe[/b]. Your saves are fine without it.
[h2]💬 Feedback & source code[/h2] Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment below, or visit the project on GitHub: 👉 [url=https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-NAME/FasterFrameFinishing]Faster Frame Finishing on GitHub[/url]
[i]Thanks for playing, and happy building! 🛠️[/i]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription: Faster Frame Finishing Makes the last step of building a steel frame (plastic sheet + screwdriver) 5x faster: 2.0 s becomes 0.4 s. Features - Adjustable speed, or instant mode - Still uses 1 plastic sheet and your screwdriver - All other building steps stay normal - Safe to add or remove; saves are not affected - Server does not need it Settings Main menu > Workshop > select this mod > Mod Configuration panel. - SpeedMultiplier: 1 = normal, 5 = default, up to 100 - InstantFinish: finish almost instantly - Enabled: turn the mod off without uninstalling Restart the game after changing a setting. Requires StationeersLaunchPad.
